topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Oh no, I can’t believe it! The party’s off? But we had everything planned, down to the last streamer! You should’ve seen the place, man, it was gonna be epic. I know you’d been looking forward to it for weeks, and I thought everyone was excited, too. I bet they just got cold feet because they were worried about something petty, like logistics or timing. Listen, let’s take control of this. We don’t need a ‘surprise’ to have a good time. What do you say we just do it our way, create our own moment? It’ll be even better, you’ll see.
